# Best Index for the Long Term, Top-Performing Markets of 2025 & More

## The Investing Intelligence Zine

### Insightful Nuggets on Social Media

**ET Money**

@ETMONEY · 28 Dec 2026

Three friends started a ₹10,000 SIP in Nifty 50, Next 50, Midcap 150 & Smallcap 250.

- **A went Aggressive:** 35% Nifty + 35% Next 50 + 15% Midcap + 15% Smallcap
- **B was Balanced:** (35% Mid + 35% Small + 15% Nifty + 15% Next 50)
- **C was Conservative:** equal split (25% each)

₹24 lakh over 20 years grew to ₹1 CRORE+ for all.

Who came on top?

A 🧵
